title: Freerunner #4
author: Todd
rules:
Online play: https://sudokupad.app/g7u1tmga3w

You're a parkour runner leaping between rooftops in a Sudoku district. You've got great control over your jumps: each jump can go up at most one floor, and down at most two floors. Be careful and enjoy!

Sudoku: Place digits 1–9 so that each digit appears exactly once in every row, column, and 3×3 box.

Skyscrapers: A number outside the grid tells how many buildings are visible in that row or column from that side. Taller buildings hide shorter ones behind them.

Parkour line: Digits are building heights. Gray lines are parkour lines that visit buildings in order, starting from the circled cell. From one building to the next you may go only if the height changes by exactly +1, +0, −1 or −2.

Other puzzles:

Freerunner #2: 000VPP.

Freerunner #3: 000VYT.

Mind the Edge ! #0: 000VE7.

Magic 30: 000UVI.

More of my games: hitodd.com.
solutionCode: Enter the digits along the parkour line starting at R6C2, in order.(8 digits)
